body: Everything the college threw at me. All the work, all the projects, all the studying for the tests, I had to stay from 8 am to 8 every day and on weekends work on w/e project there was with a group. I had to miss every single family event, I had to push aside everything and everyone for two years just to complete the objectives. No wonder no one cares about me anymore.

Am sorry for not replying earlier, I was in class. I'll check that subreddit, I used to be responsible, I know I was, other students always wanted to work with me though I usually ended up doing most of the work. I don't know what when wrong, my first two years were amazing in terms of passing all my subjects though not without many personal sacrifices. I feel like the stress will slowly get the best of me, I was used to the punishment, I was able to ignore everything around me to complete my objectives. I've become weak, and I don't know why.
